00057 class RGBAColour
00058 {
00059 public:
00060  RGBAColour(float red, float green, float blue, float alpha = 1.f) throw() 
00061  : r(red), g(green), b(blue), a(alpha) 
00062  { 
00063   ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00064   ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00065   ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00066   ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);
00067  }
00068  
00069  RGBAColour(double red, double green, double blue, double alpha = 1.0) throw() 
00070  : r((float)red), g((float)green), b((float)blue), a((float)alpha) 
00071  { 
00072   ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00073   ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00074   ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00075   ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);  
00076  }
00077  
00078  RGBAColour(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha = 255) throw() 
00079  : r(red / 255.f), g(green / 255.f), b(blue / 255.f), a(alpha / 255.f) 
00080  {
00081   ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00082   ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00083   ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00084   ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);  
00085  }
00086  
00087  RGBAColour(unsigned int rgba = 0x000000FF) throw()
00088  {
00089   a = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f; rgba = rgba >> 8;
00090   b = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f; rgba = rgba >> 8;
00091   g = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f; rgba = rgba >> 8;
00092   r = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;
00093   
00094   ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00095   ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00096   ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00097   ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);  
00098  }
00099  
00100 #ifdef UGEN_JUCE
00101  RGBAColour(juce::Colour const& juceColour) throw()
00102  : r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00103  {
00104   r = juceColour.getFloatRed();
00105   g = juceColour.getFloatGreen();
00106   b = juceColour.getFloatBlue();
00107   a = juceColour.getFloatAlpha();
00108  }
00109  
00110  operator juce::Colour () throw()
00111  {
00112   return juce::Colour(get32bitColour());
00113  }
00114 #endif
00115  
00116 #ifdef UGEN_IPHONE
00117  RGBAColour(CGColorRef colourRef)
00118  : r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00119  {
00120   memcpy(getFloatArray(), CGColorGetComponents(colourRef), 4 * sizeof(float));  
00121  }
00122  // 
00123  // RGBAColour(UIColor* col)
00124  // : r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00125  // {
00126  //  memcpy(getFloatArray(), CGColorGetComponents(colourRef), 4 * sizeof(float));  
00127  // } 
00128 #endif 
00129  
00130  inline float red() throw()  { return r; }
00131  inline float green() throw() { return g; }
00132  inline float blue() throw()  { return b; }
00133  inline float alpha() throw() { return a; }
00134  
00135  inline unsigned long redInt() throw()  { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(r*255.f); return ret; }
00136  inline unsigned long greenInt() throw()  { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(g*255.f); return ret; }
00137  inline unsigned long blueInt() throw()  { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(b*255.f); return ret; }
00138  inline unsigned long alphaInt() throw()  { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(a*255.f); return ret; }
00139  
00140  inline unsigned long get32bitColour() throw() 
00141  { 
00142   unsigned long ret = ((alphaInt() << 24) | (redInt() << 16) | (greenInt() << 8) | blueInt()); 
00143   return ret;
00144  }
00145  
00146  inline float* getFloatArray() throw() { return &r; }
00147  
00148  static const RGBAColour& getNull() throw()
00149  {
00150   static RGBAColour null;
00151   return null;
00152  }
00153  
00154 private:
00155  float r,g,b,a;
00156 };
